## Minecraft Version Support

## Core Mods

- [BBS FS](https://modrinth.com/mod/bbs-fs)
- [Axiom](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom)
- [Chisels & Bits - For Fabric](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chisels-bits-for-fabric)
